reviews.comment: Professor Rossi is one of the most caring professors I've taken so far. 351 is obviously a hard and lecture heavy course, but prof. Rossi makes it as easy as he can, for students to succeed. He will explain topics multiple times if needed, is fairly accessible, gives enough practice material and allows cheat sheets to do well on exams and projects.

I took Professor Rossi last Spring. This was by far the hardest class I have ever taken. The only reason that I would not give it one star is because he is genuinely very nice and caring. However, what is taught in class, what is in the textbook, and what is assigned for homework all differ from what is on the test. Would not recommend this class.

He makes lectures so difficult to understand that almost every day I walked out more confused then when I went it. Not to mention he specifically told us to skip a chapter and not do the homework for that material and then had 4 or 5 exam questions about that material. Exams are ridiculously difficult, take anyone else.

For reference I got an A in 229 and 341 and I haven't gotten anywhere near a B on a single test in this course. Absolutely nothing makes sense during lecture especially bc his writing isnt legible and he talks to us like we are 4 years deep into finance. Great dude but RIDICULOUSLY difficult.

great prof!! knew nothing about investments before this class, and he really really helped me learn without teaching too fast! exams only half of your grade, a B is definitely feasible. projects take a while, but they help you learn a lot. definitely take him for 351 if you get the chance! such a caring prof. cheat sheet and excel allowed on exams
Don't take this class, for the sake of your own sanity. The group projects hurt. They take so much longer than they should. His tests aren't terrible but you will need to study a good amount.
If you want to learn he is an incredible teacher. By far the best I have had. If you are in finance he teaches you how to create informed decisions with real examples. Learned a ton.

His lectures are very depressing and can go on tangents. The only assignments we had were two exams and three group projects (group part is optional but I strongly advise it). Each of the exams and projects are worth 20% of the grade. I recommend doing the suggested problems he gives you. The exams are the hardest part. (it is Rossi, not Rossia)
